dataset: Per-instance outputs of HELM Classic release v0.4.0 (Stanford CRFM): every dyck_language run listed in runs_to_run_suites.json, test split, all trials. Only run names, instance ids, trials, classes, counts and public model names are published.
note: ind = HELM's exact_match_indicator (last space-separated token only); strict = whole closing sequence, whitespace ignored; lenient = the prediction's bracket characters equal the gold sequence. wrong = indicator credits that are not lenient (classes missing_leading, extra_leading, wrong_same_length, other). under = lenient answers HELM scored 0. Cells: mean of a run's trial means.
